name: Dark Matter

specialAbility.name: Void Crush
specialAbility.description: Opens a swirling black hole that crushes the enemy with the power of deep space, dealing damage equal to 40% of their max health!

lore: Dark Matter came from the deepest, darkest corner of outer space where no light can escape. Its body is so black it looks like a truck-shaped hole in the universe, with tiny purple stars swirling around it like a galaxy. When it activates Void Crush, a mini black hole opens up right under the enemy and squeezes them with the force of a collapsing star. Seriously spooky, seriously awesome!
